moat.title: Why this becomes hard to copy.
moat.subtitle: SpacePilot compounds proprietary data with every scan, project and handover — a moat that strengthens with use.
moat.1.title: Listing Performance Passport
moat.1.body: A durable record of each listing's leaks, fixes and scenario outcomes. The more listings we passport, the sharper every diagnosis becomes.
moat.2.title: Room Upgrade Graph
moat.2.body: A graph of which fixes unlock which uplift, learned from real projects. It maps the highest-ROI next move per room type and market.
moat.3.title: SKU Kit Library
moat.3.body: Curated, costed, install-rated components bundled into kits. Each completed project tightens pricing, lead times and substitution logic.
moat.4.title: Supplier Trust Ledger
moat.4.body: On-time, rework, photo-handover and response data per partner. Trust scores route work to proven local delivery — and raise switching cost.
moat.5.title: Photo & Listing Integrity Guardrails
moat.5.body: Rules that block fabricated amenities, fake photos and hidden defects. Trust with hosts and platforms is the durable distribution edge.
moat.6.title: Before/After Impact Tracker
moat.6.body: Captured before/after evidence per project. Verified outcomes calibrate every future scenario estimate and prove ROI honestly.
